hooks.command: cd /home/user/ReLay && git fetch origin && git pull origin $(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD) 2>/dev/null || true

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath' | { read -r f; if [ -n "$f" ] && [ -d /home/user/ReLay/.git ]; then cd /home/user/ReLay && git add "$f" 2>/dev/null && git commit -m "auto: $(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')" --allow-empty 2>/dev/null && git push -u origin $(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD) 2>/dev/null || true; fi; } 2>/dev/null || true
